title: Giống, khác: comparing people and things

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say yes, or there is —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: có] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say hungry —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đói] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say right?, isn't that so? —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: phải không] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to make an appointment, or arrange to meet —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hẹn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say to meet —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: gặp] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say schedule, or calendar —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: lịch] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị đó giống em không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ không, chị đó khác em.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Khác thế nào?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Chị đó cao hơn.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today, two words for comparing.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: giống] [EN: means similar, or alike. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: . Listen again.] [VI_F: giống] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: giống] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: giống] [EN: Good. She looks like me —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị đó giống em.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: khác] [EN: means different. You already heard it inside] [VI: loại khác] [EN: — a different kind. Today it stands on its own, still meaning different. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: too. Listen again.] [VI_F: khác] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: khác] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khác] [EN: Good. She's different from me —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị đó khác em.]
[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Similar, alike —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: giống] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Different —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khác] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. Similar, alike —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: giống] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Different —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: khác] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now build it. He looks like me —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Anh đó giống em.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: This shirt is different —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Áo này khác.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: She's different from me, she's taller —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị đó khác em, chị đó cao hơn.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: giống] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: similar, alike] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: khác] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: different] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: giống] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: khác] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: giống] [EN: and] [VI: khác] [EN: both have] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: .]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị đó giống em không?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ không, chị đó khác em.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Khác thế nào?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Chị đó cao hơn.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. Say she's different from me.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị đó khác em.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next lesson, introductions. One word to start —] [VI: giới thiệu] [EN: it means to introduce. See you then.]
